name: Ragau
overview: Ragau, also called Reu, is a key figure in the genealogical line tracing from Peleg to Jesus Christ, as shown in Genesis 11 and Luke 3. Scripture records that Peleg begat Reu, who in turn begat Serug, continuing the lineage that ultimately leads to Christ (Genesis 11:18-21; Luke 3:35). This genealogy highlights God’s sovereign preservation of the Messianic line through successive generations, emphasizing the faithfulness of His promises from the earliest times.
